scope: 41 existing catalog dossiers plus money guide; bounded linked-source audit, not a claim to have crawled entire sites.

catalog.cheetah: The Ultimate Edition Cheetah arrives later in the story. Its retro livery celebrates Shore Drive; the exact chapter remains a launch check.
catalog.stanier: The preorder pack pairs this classic with Shore Court garage. GTABase also identifies the yellow-and-white car outside Ocean View Hotel.
catalog.buggy: Head for Paradise Garage in Watson Bay. Its locker and stolen-goods storage support longer trips into Mount Kalaga.
catalog.enduro: Jason’s Ultimate Edition Enduro wears an army-style livery at his safehouse; this is a personal-vehicle benefit.
catalog.kayak: The Ultimate Edition adds Jason’s personal Crest Kayak. Its single-seat layout differs from a two-person getaway boat.
catalog.squalo: The special pink-and-blue Squalo is docked at Washington Beach, with an explosives crate. Keep its edition variant distinct from the standard boat.
catalog.ganado: Jason already has a personal Ganado. The Ultimate Edition supplies exclusive retro modifications rather than introducing the base car.
catalog.airgator: Seen in Grassrivers imagery: the rear fan and elevated seating identify this airboat. Sightings are exploration leads, not guaranteed spawns.
catalog.alvino: Jason’s official screenshot provides the sighting. The Ducati Panigale V2 comparison describes its design, not verified acceleration or grip.
catalog.banshee: GTABase identifies the Trailer 2 sports car as a Bravado Banshee. Its Dodge Viper influence is clearer than its untested performance.
catalog.blazer: A compact Yamaha YFZ450-inspired quad, identified in Trailer 1. Trail suitability is a role comparison; final terrain rankings need testing.
catalog.cyan-convertible: The Ocean Drive sighting is catalogued as a Pegassi Zorrusso. Its Italdesign Zerouno influence explains the open-top supercar silhouette.
catalog.delmar: BTN Delmar identifies the real vessel used for comparison. The GTA name and whether players can pilot it await confirmation.
catalog.dodo: The DHC-2 Beaver-inspired floatplane appears in Leonida Keys imagery. A flying sighting does not establish a collectible spawn.
catalog.lurepredator: The L35P has a separately catalogued police variant. Keep that patrol boat distinct from the civilian fishing boat.
catalog.news-heli: Look for N88892, red-and-white news markings and skid landing gear. The exact aircraft model and player access remain open.
catalog.police-montagne: GTABase identifies this Explorer-inspired emergency SUV as the Police Montagne, a police variant of the civilian Montagne.
catalog.rancher: The Rancher identification spans different community body-style comparisons. Confirm the exact pictured variant before attaching seating or handling specifications.
catalog.schafter: The Schafter name is visible on the boot in the Extended Look. Its trim remains unresolved; avoid borrowing V12 specifications.
catalog.seashark: The Sea-Doo-inspired watercraft is visible in official footage. Its presence does not establish rental locations or repeatable beach spawns.
catalog.yellow-bike: Suzuki GSX-R1000 is a design comparison, not its announced GTA model name. The specific yellow-bike identification remains provisional.
catalog.girardi: Jason’s engraved ES9 is an Ultimate Edition variant. The underlying pistol’s shop and pickup route remain a launch check.
catalog.klose: Lucia’s engraved K17 is an Ultimate Edition variant. Its Glock/P320 influence does not establish real-world magazine capacity in GTA VI.
catalog.mustang: Shown with Final Chapter MC in Ambrosia. That identifies a user and region, not a guaranteed loot drop.
catalog.nipper: The compact pistol blends Taurus PT938 and Bersa Firestorm styling. A .38 name alone does not confirm its ammo mechanics.
catalog.duke: This Duke-branded carbine follows the Colt M4 family. Treat published legacy-style magazine figures as provisional until verified in GTA VI.
catalog.moreland: The Moreland 850 appears in the Extended Look. Its Remington 870 influence identifies the design, not a tested damage rating.
catalog.revolvers: The Ultimate variants add Vercetti Estate styling, etched grips and a scope. The Morgan name is a reported Arthur Morgan reference.
catalog.m1a-inspired-rifle: A poacher carries the scoped rifle on a Grassrivers airboat. Use this as a visual lead, not a confirmed pickup.
catalog.weapon-variants: Personalized engravings pair Jason’s Girardi ES9 with Lucia’s Klose K17. Cosmetic identification does not establish stronger damage.
catalog.vice-style: Outfits, hairstyles and tattoos for both protagonists form this Ultimate Edition collection.
catalog.vintage-style: The Vintage Vice City preorder pack includes outfits and hairstyles. Access follows the eligible pack entitlement.
catalog.weapon-pattern: The preorder pack’s exclusive pattern changes weapon styling; a combat-stat advantage has not been established.
catalog.goodtime: Macca the Gator’s television persona inspires this apparel-and-accessories collection.
catalog.rideout: Rideout specializes in donk styling, distinctive rims and detailed interiors.
catalog.saras: Sara’s serves both characters, including Jason’s facial hair and Lucia’s makeup and nails.
catalog.stock305: Find the streetwear store in Stockyard. Its exclusive looks cover both Jason and Lucia.
catalog.electric-fang: Stockyard’s tattoo studio offers more than 50 designs by artist collective FAILE.
catalog.willie: Lake Leonida’s workshop focuses on off-road modifications and hand-painted automotive details.
catalog.ptt: The Ultimate Edition lists the PTT Youngin$ compound. Treat the special raid separately from ordinary gang-compound opportunities.
catalog.wyman-collection: Deliver recovered project-car components to Wyman. GTABase lists Deviant, Mamba GT, Riata Classic and Sirius among the collection’s vehicles.

common.editionAccess: Ultimate bonuses open across story chapters. Owning the edition does not mean every benefit is available immediately.
common.weaponAccess: Check each Ammu-Nation’s local stock: stores can carry special guns. Every branch has a locker, and owned weapons remain accessible through personal-vehicle storage.
common.weaponRecovery: A preview demonstrated a shotgun taken from an unattended police-car trunk. The model and repeatable locations were not identified.
common.performance: Ready for launch testing: compare matched upgrades, conditions and terrain before choosing a speed or handling winner.

groups.title: Pick a score
groups.text: Choose a shop, valuable car, jewelry target or compound that your current tools and contacts can support.

groups.title: Keep the take
groups.text: Separate stolen goods from spendable cash. Sell through the right buyer, then deposit cash before taking another risk.

groups.title: Build your next run
groups.text: Track actual costs, take and travel time. A useful routine follows your results rather than promising a fixed payout.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Set a target, buyer and exit. Check tools, vehicle condition and fuel before committing.

steps.title: Escape
steps.text: Watch what police know: your vehicle, clothes, weapon and partner can keep you recognizable.

steps.title: Sell
steps.text: Deliver the correct loot to an available fence. Vehicle damage can reduce the offer; compare repair cost with the improvement.

steps.title: Deposit
steps.text: Carried cash can be lost on death. Finish at an ATM, then log what reached the bank.

stocks.title: Stocks & investments
stocks.text: The official material and previews checked do not confirm stock trading in GTA VI. Banking is confirmed; that does not establish an exchange, tradable shares or investment missions.
stocks.history: GTA V had stock-market systems. Its companies, mission trades and returns should not be carried over as GTA VI instructions.
stocks.next: At release, check for an investment app, named exchanges, unlock conditions and whether story events affect prices.

newFacts: Some story jobs require earning money in free roam before continuing.
WAINK lists vehicles wanted by fences alongside security and tracking information.
Pay’n’Spray has a cooldown between vehicle sales at the same branch; its duration still needs testing.
Purchased weapons and spare outfits in your personal vehicle make preparation more useful than an improvised escape.

correction.issue: GTABase calls this edition-exclusive activity required for 100% completion and non-time-sensitive, without an evident primary supporting statement.
correction.action: Do not adopt the 100%-required or post-story availability claims. Retain official special commission and attributed component collection.

importantCorrections.issue: Existing profile suggests a Police Maverick-derived news variant. The accessible frame-analysis source says the aircraft maker and donor remain unresolved; its Swift/AW109 comparison is explicitly unreliable.
importantCorrections.action: Use descriptive news helicopter identity and visible registration; do not present an airframe family as confirmed.

importantCorrections.issue: Existing identity says BTN name visible and includes an irrelevant Kayak source. GTABase explicitly uses BTN Delmar as the real-world reference while the in-game name is unknown.
importantCorrections.action: Use descriptive large vessel identity and mark BTN Delmar as influence; remove irrelevant Kayak source.

importantCorrections.issue: Current profile describes a two-door pickup, whereas GTABase presents a four-seat Suburban-derived off-road vehicle. Likely variant identification disagreement.
importantCorrections.action: Keep visible body description separate from generic Rancher specs; do not import four-seat or weight figures without matching image variant.

importantCorrections.issue: GTABase data says two seats while its recycled description says four seats.
importantCorrections.action: Do not add a seat-count claim from this inconsistent page. Current omission is appropriate.

importantCorrections.issue: GTABase lists 30/60-round magazines alongside GTA Online Service Carbine copy and unfinished VI statistics.
importantCorrections.action: No new verified ammo statistic. Attribute as secondary/provisional only if retained.

importantCorrections.issue: GTABase describes Ocean View Hotel as an always-available spawn before launch, while official preorder material describes a pack and garage.
importantCorrections.action: Keep the hotel a reported sighting/lead, distinct from guaranteed preorder entitlement; avoid guaranteed respawn wording.

importantCorrections.issue: Death loss is directly confirmed by TroisCouleurs. Exact arrest penalties were not established by the primary passages read.
importantCorrections.action: Say carried cash is at risk and directly confirm death loss; avoid an exact arrest penalty.
